name: T1M8-LT2
description: T1M8-LT2 was an orange- and green-plated A-LT Utility Droid that was forced to work in the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 10 BBY, T1M8-LT2 was freed from slavery after its restraining bolt was removed during a slave revolt in the mines started by the droid L3-37.
